BI Developer - Marlowe Grain Cooperative

About the role
Marlowe supplies grain and feed to farms across the region. Our BI team is building a new reporting layer on a cloud data warehouse. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Build dashboards and reports for sales and finance
- Develop ETL jobs that feed the warehouse
- Work with stakeholders to define metrics

Requirements
- SQL
- Tableau
- ETL development
- Python scripting
- Snowflake data warehouse
- Stakeholder reporting

Nice to have
- Looker

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
